'''Karoon Bogat''' was an [[Aki-Aki]] from the [[planet]] [[Pasaana]]. During the [[First Order]] [[Battle of Batuu|occupation]] of the planet [[Batuu]] in [[34 ABY]], there was a 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]] [[bounty]] on Bogat for [[Thief|theft]] and evading arrest, which was claimed by a visitor to [[Black Spire Outpost]] on Batuu who used a [[thermal scanner]] to locate Bogat hiding in the outpost.

In [[35 ABY]], Bogat attended the [[Festival of the Ancestors]] on Pasaana and witnessed the [[death]] of the [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[FN-2802]] as he attempted to apprehend several [[Resistance]] agents. Shocked by the death, Bogat trembled while comforted by adult Aki-Aki.

==Biography==
[[File:KaroonBogat-TROS.png|thumb|left|225px|Karoon Bogat witnessed the death of FN-2802 on Pasaana.]]
Karoon Bogat was an [[Aki-Aki]] from [[Pasaana]],<ref name="BBH" /> the [[desert]] [[homeworld]] of the Aki-Aki [[species]].<ref name="TROS VD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> While a teenager<ref name="Teenager">{{DatapadCite|''[[Star Wars: Batuu Bounty Hunters]]''|BatuuBountyHunters-KaroonBogat.png}} shows Karoon Bogat with what ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' describes as a teenage complexion for an Aki-Aki.</ref> in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="GEDates">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]] to [[34 ABY]].</ref> Bogat had a 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]] [[bounty]] on their head for [[Thief|theft]] and evading arrest. While hiding in a building in [[Black Spire Outpost]] on the [[planet]] [[Batuu]] during the world's [[Battle of Batuu|occupation]] by the [[First Order]], Bogat was discovered by a visitor to the outpost using a [[thermal scanner]]. The visitor, whom the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]] had assigned Bogat's bounty, then reported the Aki-Aki's location to the local [[Guildmaster's Hideout]] in order to claim the reward.<ref name="BBH" />

In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]].</ref> Bogat attended the [[Festival of the Ancestors]] in the [[Forbidden Valley]] on Pasaana. During the festivities, Bogat was part of a crowd that witnessed the [[First Order stormtrooper]] [[FN-2802]] attempt to apprehend several [[Resistance]] agents. The [[trooper]] held the agents at [[blaster]]point, but as<ref name="TROS" /> he<ref name="TROS AD">{{Film|IX}} {{C|[[Disney+]] audio description}}</ref> reported having found them, he was shot through the [[eye]] and [[Death|killed]] by the hermit [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], shocking Bogat and other observers. As the Resistance agents fled with Calrissian, Bogat trembled while one adult Aki-Aki hugged the teenager close, one held back a [[Limb|hand]] to keep Bogat away from the corpse, and a third lent in to check on the [[youngling]].<ref name="TROS" />

==Personality and traits==
Karoon Bogat had [[Color|black]] eyes and mottled pink and brown skin.<ref name="TROS" />

==Equipment==
While on Batuu<ref name="BBH" /> and Pasaana, Bogat wore a yellow hooded [[Clothing|robe]] with a pink patterned shawl over it and brown [[boot]]s.<ref name="TROS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Karoon Bogat first appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="TROS" /> The character was then identified in ''[[Star Wars: Batuu Bounty Hunters]]'', an augmented-reality [[Star Wars video games|video game]] launched at [[Wikipedia:Walt Disney World|Walt Disney World]]<ref name="BBH" /> on [[July 27]], [[2022]].<ref name="DPB Launching">{{DPB|url=2022/07/magicbandplus-launching-july-27-at-walt-disney-world|text=MagicBand+ Launching July 27 at Walt Disney World|nolive=1}}</ref>
